pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on sequential averaging or adding positions within 2 points of prior entries during high-velocity moves to eliminate clustered stop-outs like tickets 2123016852 and 2123016855.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero order execution allowed within 15 minutes of major macroeconomic news releases or when 1-minute ATR expands by more than 300 percent above the 20-period moving average.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate trailing structural stops or trigger partial harvesting the moment floating profit crosses $10.00 to prevent unrealized gains from evaporating back to breakeven or micro-losses.
